project_type: LaTeX academic review article on Deep Learning for Earthquake Early Warning
test_framework: LaTeX compilation (no test framework, success = PDF compiles without errors)
build_command: cd /projects/sandbox/sonet-product/artikel_review_2 && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex && bibtex main && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex
verification_instructions: 1. Run pdflatex+bibtex triple-pass to compile. 2. Check no LaTeX errors. 3. Verify new citations resolve (no undefined references). 4. Confirm PDF output exists and is valid.
snapshot_or_generated_files: main.pdf, main.aux, main.bbl, main.blg, main.log, main.out, main.spl - all regenerated by LaTeX compilation
setup_instructions: texlive is already installed. No additional setup needed.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. LaTeX texlive available. Python 3.11 available if needed for scripting.
contribution_requirements: Article is on branch feat/dl-eew-single-multi-station-review. All changes go to artikel_review_2/ directory.
key_patterns: elsarticle document class with authoryear citations. Uses \citep{} and \citet{} for citations. BibTeX entries follow standard format. Article has 9 sections covering intro, fundamentals, DL foundations, single-station, multi-station, comparative, datasets, deployment, future directions, conclusions.
directory_structure: artikel_review_2/ contains main.tex (1084 lines, the article), references.bib (957 lines, 96 entries), and LaTeX build artifacts (main.pdf, .aux, .bbl, .blg, .log, .out, .spl)
